expo.name: Nanospeed

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Nanospeed uses the camera to scan images of diagnostic testing kits to extract and process test results.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Nanospeed uses photo library access to allow users to upload or select diagnostic images from storage for processing.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Nanospeed does not use the microphone for any purpose.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Required only if device connectivity is used for medical data sync (not applicable in current version).

plugins.cameraPermissionText: Nanospeed uses your camera to scan test kit results for health data input.

expo.description: Nanospeed is currently authorized for use in select regions with relevant regulatory compliance for diagnostic hardware. Consult documentation or contact us for details.
